1 ἀποκυκτικήν ('turning away') the codex has. γήρους ('of old age') the codex has. 2 γενωμένῳ ('having become') the codex has. παραθητικῶν ('of placements') is corrupt.

summary.headline: Fixed Stars and Planetary Mixtures
summary.text: Discussion of fixed stars, their relationships with planets and the Moon, and their effects on birth, temperament, life, death, and posthumous generation. The author cites Sypheus and Ptolemy and introduces a new diagrammatic table of celestial wisdom and knowledge.
